## Video (under 3:00)

Start with the demo, not slides. Show the product within the first 30 seconds.

| Time | What we show | What we say |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0:00-0:20 | The moment of need, in the product | The problem in one sentence, about one customer |
| 0:20-1:40 | The demo path, click by click | What the customer sees and why it matters |
| 1:40-2:20 | How it works and scales (one diagram or the scale view) | Rules for detection, AI for words, 2.3M customers |
| 2:20-2:50 | Trust: consent, "why am I seeing this", human handover | Privacy, explainability, security |
| 2:50-3:00 | The closing line | |
